# Vaidik Ghelani — Software Studio
> https://vaidikghelani.com

## About
Vaidik Ghelani is an independent software studio based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.
Senior full-stack MERN & Next.js developer specializing in building serious digital products,
AI chatbot/calling integrations, and SaaS MVPs.

## Services
1. MERN Stack Development — Custom high-performance web applications and dashboards built with MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js.
2. AI & Automation Integration — Conversational AI chatbots, voice calling agents, and automated workflow pipelines.
3. SaaS MVP Development — Rapid, validation-focused product development to get your SaaS MVP to market in weeks.

## Technologies
React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, PostgreSQL,
Redis, Firebase, Stripe, OpenAI API, Docker, Vercel, AWS
